self_authentication_categories.1450: Official seals/signatures of public employees within their jurisdiction

key_doctrine: Rebuttable presumption — competent rebuttal evidence defeats the presumption and throws the proponent back to §1400(a) extrinsic evidence burden
citizen_relevance: §§1450-1454 are the self-authentication presumptions that opposing parties rely on to admit contested government documents without live authentication testimony. The rebuttable-presumption structure is the attack vector: evidence that the claimed originating agency does not have the document in its records (OPD records pickup) defeats §1450 and requires extrinsic authentication under §1400(a). Critical for contested police reports, court records, and pension administration documents.
